baseline_models.focus_anchor: Creation at word 2 is qualified by truth at word 8 and a designated term at words 9-10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation is an act of prior measure: truth fixes correspondence, while the designated term supplies a temporal limit. Spatial order and duration therefore belong to one calibrated construction.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring supplies the design operation behind creation rather than treating it as bare production.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the norm embodied by the design.
A fixed temporal limit closes the design instead of leaving it indefinite.
Naming makes the term a designated and intelligible boundary; the same source root also occurs at the heavenly endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely says that the universe was created and will end.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a calibrated order whose truth, spatial extent, and designated duration are parts of one design.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 3-6 name the upper and lower endpoints together with what lies between them; word 8 qualifies the whole construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The middle is not leftover emptiness. It can be the connection that holds distinct endpoints in relation, while truth supplies a fitted articulation. Creation includes relations and intervals as positively made structure.

activation_trace.role: The overhanging upper realm supplies one boundary of the spatial construction.
The lower realm opposed to the sky supplies the other boundary.
A connection standing between endpoints turns the interval into relational infrastructure.
A part fitting its proper joint or receptacle gives the relational structure a material image of exact articulation.

changed_reading.before: Creation consists of two large objects with an unspecified empty gap.
changed_reading.after: Creation includes the connective field between upper and lower realms, fitted as carefully as the endpoints themselves.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 12-15 link refusal, warning, and a bodily act of turning aside.
baseline_models.mechanism: The closing clause describes a sequence of attention rather than a static identity: warning is meant to awaken caution, refusal covers what is true, and turning presents the side instead of the face. The response works against disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Notice of danger is meant to wake caution, supplying the signal to which a response is due.
Covering supplies the first counter-operation against a signal that could otherwise become visible.
Blocking acknowledged truth specifies what the covering does at the epistemic level.
Turning one's side supplies the bodily orientation that sustains the refusal.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief is an abstract label attached to people who happen not to accept a warning.
changed_reading.after: Refusal is an active attentional counter-process: a danger signal arrives, is covered, and is kept off-axis by bodily and interpretive turning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split inventory for the source root at words 3 and 10 allows the designated term to activate marking and seasonality alongside naming.
baseline_models.mechanism: Through the non-dominant mapped root, designation can be imagined as an identifying mark or a marked season. The term may therefore be not only verbally named but sign-bearing within the created field.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark gives the designated term a potentially legible boundary.
A marked time of gathering contributes a seasonal and collective sense to the designation.
The fixed limit keeps the mark attached to a real temporal boundary rather than a free symbol.

changed_reading.before: The term is called by a name but otherwise remains invisible.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the term is a marked season or legible boundary whose signs may appear within creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding delivered book combines arrival, binding inscription, and precise governance. This strengthens the baseline measure model by making the truthful term not only built into creation but also promulgated within it.

activation_trace.role: Binding obligation lets truth function as an enforceable norm in the focus.
The fixed limit supplies the decree's temporal content.
Caused delivery makes the governing communication arrive inside the created order.
A written establishment that obligates judgment or destiny supplies the decree mechanism.
Precision, sound construction, and reliability connect the decree to the focus ayah's calibrated order.

structural_cues: 46:2 immediately precedes the focus and moves from a delivered book to the created order without an intervening scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, delivery, binding record, and precision. The reader supplies the arrow that the delivered record governs and announces the focus term. Live alternative: the book may attest the order without enacting it.

changed_reading.before: Truth and term are silent properties embedded in the cosmos.
changed_reading.after: Truth and term are also a communicated decree: creation is governed by a boundary that has been delivered and made knowable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah tests rival authorship by asking for a visible contribution to earth or a share in heaven, then for a document or surviving trace of knowledge. Creation 'with truth' becomes an evidentiary standard rather than only an ontological claim.

activation_trace.role: Actual origination supplies the authorship claim being tested.
Correspondence with reality supplies the criterion by which a creator claim stands or fails.
A pointed request to inspect and answer converts the cosmological assertion into a test.
The demand to identify any rival act of origination localizes the burden of proof.
Participation or shared ownership supplies the alternative authorship hypothesis.
A surviving mark that points back to a prior cause supplies material evidence.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic condition for admissible evidence.
Truthful speech makes the challengers accountable for matching their claim to evidence.

structural_cues: 46:4 repeats creation, earth, and heavens, then frames them with imperatives to show and bring evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated cosmic terms, interrogatives, partnership, document, trace, knowledge, and truthfulness. The reader supplies the rule that an authorship claim must leave inspectable evidence. Live alternative: the passage may be a narrower cultic challenge rather than a general epistemology.

changed_reading.before: Creation with truth is a proposition accepted on assertion.
changed_reading.after: Creation with truth establishes a burden of proof: alleged partners should show a contribution, share, record, or causal trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs are recoded as deceptive magic and then alleged fabrication. This activates the focus root's distant fabrication branch, setting truthful divine making against counterfeit verbal making and a false reassignment of authorship.

activation_trace.role: Genuine origination supplies one pole of the contrast.
Invented speech supplies a latent counterfeit mode of making within the focus root.
Blocking truth explains why authentic making can be relabeled as counterfeit.
An evident sign supplies material that should disclose rather than conceal its source.
Diversion and deception supply the hostile relabeling imposed on the sign.
Fabricated falsehood directly activates the counterfeit-making branch in the focus.

structural_cues: 46:7 first calls the signs clear and then records the label of magic; 46:8 repeats the fabrication charge in accusation and conditional reply.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies evident signs, deception, and repeated fabrication language. The reader supplies the contrast between two branches of the focus creation root. Live alternative: the fabrication charge may concern only the recitation and need not echo cosmic creation.

changed_reading.before: The creation clause and the refusal clause are adjacent but mechanistically separate.
changed_reading.after: The refusal clause performs counterfeit creation: it covers true making by manufacturing and assigning a false account of its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pregnancy, weaning, maturity, departed generations, and full repayment introduce nested biological, generational, and accounting thresholds. The designated term can now be read as a scale repeated through created life, not only one remote cosmic date.

activation_trace.role: Prior measure lets life stages instantiate the same calibrated logic as cosmic creation.
A fixed duration supplies the temporal pattern expanded by later thresholds.
Internal bearing and fruiting provide an embodied interval whose completion is measured.
Separation from nursing supplies a concrete boundary within development.
Reaching a limit supplies the transition from duration to attained stage.
People bound within one age extend the temporal pattern from bodies to generations.
Completion without deficiency turns measured stages toward exact settlement.

structural_cues: 46:15 explicitly sequences bearing, birth, separation, thirty months, maturity, and forty years; 46:17-19 widen the scale to generations and graded repayment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit developmental thresholds, generations, and full settlement. The reader supplies the scaling relation from those clocks back to the focus term. Live alternative: the focus term may remain solely eschatological while life stages serve only as analogies.

changed_reading.before: The designated term is one distant endpoint external to ordinary life.
changed_reading.after: The designated term is also a recurrent grammar of creation: gestation, separation, maturity, generations, and recompense each reach measured bounds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus makes refusers agents who turn away; 46:20 and 46:34 make them patients who are presented for inspection. The warning predicts a reversal in control over orientation and over who is looking at whom.

activation_trace.role: Voluntarily presenting the side instead of the face supplies the initial control over orientation.
The danger notice supplies the event whose future realization is at stake.
Being brought forth for viewing reverses the refusers from orienting subjects into displayed objects.
The same truth-blocking group persists across the grammatical reversal.
The second presentation makes the reversal a repeated endpoint rather than a single incidental scene.
Truth made manifest supplies what can no longer be kept off-axis.

structural_cues: The focus active participle and the passive verbs in 46:20 and 46:34 share the same root while swapping the refusers from agents to patients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root, voice change, same group, warning, and manifested truth. The reader supplies the causal arrow from voluntary evasion to involuntary exposure. Live alternative: the repetition may be rhetorical echo without strict causal sequencing.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is a successful act of avoidance within the present moment.
changed_reading.after: Turning away is temporary control of one's viewing angle; the warned future reverses that control and makes the avoiders themselves the objects of display.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that names turning away in the focus later names what appears from a direction: an approaching cloud read as rain but corrected as the hastened wind of punishment. Warning is no longer abstract; it can arrive visibly while interpretive posture converts danger into expected benefit.

activation_trace.role: Turning the side away supplies the prior orientation that the later seeing scene tests.
A danger notice supplies the content whose visible arrival can still be misclassified.
Actual visual perception shows that the failure is not simple absence of sensory access.
Something appearing from one direction supplies the horizon object that demands interpretation.
Expected water poured from cloud supplies the beneficial forecast projected onto the appearance.
Demanding acceleration makes the approaching event partly invited rather than merely unforeseen.
Moving air replaces the expected rain and supplies the destructive event's actual medium.

structural_cues: 46:24 repeats the appearing-object form twice, attaches it to the viewers' valleys, then uses an explicit correction from expected rain to the hastened event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared root, sight, cloud expectation, correction, haste, and wind. The reader supplies the arrow from the focus posture to the later misclassification. Live alternative: the cloud scene may illustrate false expectation without explaining the earlier turning away.

changed_reading.before: The warned object is hidden future information that refusers simply decline to hear.
changed_reading.after: The warned object may stand visibly on the horizon and still be read backward as benefit; turning away includes interpretive orientation, not just absence of attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: 46:26 gives hearing but no benefit under knowing denial; 46:29 redirects listeners who hear with understanding, become attentively silent, and then turn toward their own people as warners. Warning is a relay circuit whose output depends on orientation and whose successful recipients become transmitters.

activation_trace.role: The danger notice supplies the message entering the reception circuit.
Turning aside supplies the failed orientation against which later listening is contrasted.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows the functional capacity that produces no benefit when refused.
Denial in the presence of knowledge makes perceptual failure active rather than innocent.
Redirection from one state or course to another places receptive listeners on-axis with the message.
Understanding hearing supplies successful reception rather than mere acoustic contact.
Attentive silence supplies the disciplined posture that lets reception complete.
Turning the face toward their people supplies purposeful reorientation after listening.
The recipients becoming warners closes the relay by reproducing the original danger notice.

structural_cues: 46:26 repeats hearing as a failed faculty, while 46:29 sequences redirection, listening, silence, completion, turning, and warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unused hearing, knowing denial, redirected listeners, attentive silence, purposeful turning, and new warners. The reader supplies the process arrow from orientation through reception to retransmission. Live alternative: the contrast may be primarily between communities rather than a general reception mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Warning is a one-way signal that either reaches a person or does not.
changed_reading.after: Warning is a social relay: orientation governs whether hearing becomes understanding, and successful reception turns listeners into warners.

context_deltas.mechanism: 46:30 coordinates guidance toward truth with guidance toward a straight path. The focus truth becomes navigable direction, while turning away becomes spatial deviation from a route through the relational field of creation.

activation_trace.role: Connection between endpoints supplies the traversable relational field.
Reality-matching truth supplies the destination named in the focus.
Sideways movement and difficulty going straight give refusal a path-deviation image.
Gentle indication toward a way and toward truth supplies directional guidance.
The repeated truth root explicitly becomes what guidance moves toward.
An extended route supplies the concrete spatial mechanism for approaching truth.

structural_cues: 46:30 uses parallel directional phrases for truth and a straight route.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit guidance toward truth and toward a straight route. The reader supplies the spatialization of the focus qualifier and the contrast with sideways refusal. Live alternative: the coordinated phrases may distinguish destination from means rather than identify truth itself as a route.

changed_reading.before: Truth is a static property of creation, and turning away is generic rejection.
changed_reading.after: Truth is also a direction through creation; warning functions as wayfinding, and refusal is a sideways departure from that route.

context_deltas.mechanism: 46:33 repeats creation of heavens and earth, denies fatigue in making them, and joins that fact to power over the dead. The designated term is therefore more plausibly a planned phase boundary than a limit caused by exhausted creative capacity.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the act whose capacity is tested by the later repetition.
The fixed term supplies the boundary being reclassified from exhaustion to plan.
Repeated origination ties the later capacity claim directly back to the focus construction.
Bodily fatigue supplies the expressly negated explanation for any endpoint.
Effective capability supplies continued power beyond the present creation's term.
Loss of life supplies the state over which renewed creative power is asserted.

structural_cues: 46:33 repeats the focus triad of creation, heavens, and earth, then moves by a rhetorical question from non-fatigue to reviving the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated creation formula, negated fatigue, effective power, and death. The reader supplies the arrow that the focus term marks a planned transition rather than creator incapacity. Live alternative: the term may still denote final cosmic cessation while revival concerns individual creatures.

changed_reading.before: The appointed term can sound like the point at which creative power runs out or the order simply expires.
changed_reading.after: The appointed term is a scheduled boundary within continuing power: ending one created phase does not prevent renewed life and accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command restrains haste, fixes attention on the promised event, and says prior dwelling will appear no longer than a small part of daylight. The designated term calibrates both objective delay and the later collapse of experienced duration.

activation_trace.role: A fixed duration supplies the objective temporal boundary.
Restraint against panic supplies the proper posture while the term remains future.
Acceleration and premature advancement supply the pressure that the fixed term resists.
A promise bounded by time or place connects expectation to a determinate arrival.
Dwelling in a place supplies the duration later compressed in retrospect.
Opened daylight supplies the finite experiential scale against which the long wait is recalled.

structural_cues: 46:35 contrasts patience and non-haste with seeing the promise, then compresses prior dwelling to an hour of a day.
The hour word at 46:35 word 19 is used structurally only because its packet inventory supplies no matching hour branch ID.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, haste, timed promise, dwelling, hour, and daylight. The reader supplies the phenomenological arrow from arrival to retrospective compression. Live alternative: the small duration may be rhetorical minimization rather than a claim about experienced time.

changed_reading.before: The designated term is only an objective date on a cosmic timeline.
changed_reading.after: The term also governs temporal experience: it calls for restraint before arrival and makes the preceding delay look radically compressed once the promise is seen.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because water-holding senses of creation and term are distant from their syntax here. It remains anchored because two independent focus branches converge on retention, while 46:24 supplies valley, expected rain, and wind as an eventual release scene. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy, not a lexical gloss or asserted cosmology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The creation root at word 2 and term root at word 9 each have a water-retention branch; the later horizon scene supplies channels and weather.

activation_trace.role: A hollow or well that retains water supplies a bounded holding structure for creation.
A basin that gathers water before release to cultivation turns the term into a possible gate between retention and discharge.
A valley as a flood channel supplies the downstream path expected to receive what is released.
Water poured from cloud supplies the inhabitants' expected beneficial discharge.
Wind replacing rain supplies the actual released medium and reverses the expected benefit.

changed_reading.before: The term is only a clock attached to an otherwise static creation.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory hydraulic image, creation holds consequences within bounded storage until the term opens a release through created channels.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading treats architectural and anatomical branch images as an analogy, so it must not be rendered as a claim that the cosmos is literally an organism. It remains valid because formation, connective middle, fitting joint, lifespan, death, and renewed capacity all attach to cited focus or context roots. Downstream prose should preserve it only as an exploratory model of coordinated parts and phases.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Formation at word 2, the connective middle at word 6, fitted truth at word 8, and lifespan at word 9 can be assembled into an articulated-body analogy.

activation_trace.role: Completed and proportionate form supplies the body-like whole.
A connection maintained between endpoints supplies ligature rather than empty interval.
A fitting joint or receptacle supplies articulation among the whole's parts.
A bounded lifespan supplies the articulated whole with a phase of duration.
Loss of vitality supplies the terminal bodily state later placed under renewed power.
Effective capability supplies the possibility of reconstituting the formed whole after its term.

changed_reading.before: Heavens, earth, and their interval are separate spatial items that merely share an end date.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they form an articulated whole whose connective joints fit, whose present phase has a lifespan, and whose ending does not exhaust the power to form again.

strongest_changes: The focus refusers move from agents who turn away to patients who are repeatedly presented, reversing control over orientation.
The approaching cloud turns warning into a visible but misread horizon event: danger is interpreted as expected benefit.
Failed hearing and the later attentive listeners recast warning as a relay that can reproduce new warners.
The repeated creation formula beside non-fatigue and power over death makes the term a planned phase boundary rather than a limit of capacity.
Life stages and the final compression of remembered duration place the named term on biological, generational, ethical, and experiential scales.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates roots that the context later turns through striking role changes: ع ر ض moves from turning aside, to a horizon appearance, to forced presentation; the creation formula returns beside renewed life; and the split س م و inventory keeps a marked or seasonal term available alongside ordinary naming.
remaining_uncertainties: The marked-season reading of the designated term may be productive split-root activation rather than intended lexical force.
The cloud scene may explain the mechanism of turning away, or it may only provide a powerful root echo and example of false expectation.
The appointed term may be a phase boundary without ceasing to denote a final cosmic endpoint.
The hydraulic and articulated-body readings remain contained material analogies, not direct glosses.
